item.title: Traffic stands steady for Soo Locks, seaway
item.description: Traffic on the St. Lawrence Seaway, including the Soo Locks in Sault Ste. Marie, Mich., was on par with 2024. Last year saw 3,937 transits on the marine transportation system, down 15 from 3,952 in 2024, a release says. item.title: Sault Catholic board still projects balanced budget
item.description: Huron-Superior Catholic District School Board still expects to balance the books with a revised 2025-26 budget. The English Catholic board now expects to receive, and spend, $103,133,152 for the financial year. That’s up slightly from earlier revenue and expenditures each totaling $102,566,964.
